## [CIC/Asurint Criminal & Eviction Reports](https://crsgroupinc.egnyte.com/dl/6p4BjqQvByHh/CRS_Credit_API_-_CIC_Reports.md_)

Use the CIC/Asurint Reports endpoints to order either a **Criminal Report** or an **Eviction Report**. Both report types follow the same endpoint pattern.

| Parameter | Supported value |
| --- | --- |
| `{report}` | `criminal` or `eviction` |

**Environment:** The examples below use the CRS sandbox at `https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com`.

---

## 1\. Order a report

``` http
POST https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{report}/new-request

 ```

This request returns a JSON CIC/Asurint report for the identity submitted in the request body.

### Important response data

- Capture the `RequestID` response header. You will use it to generate the PDF report.
    
- If the response requires CIC/Asurint review, capture `orderResponse.responseID`. You will use it to poll for the finalized report in Step 3.
    

### Tenant-screening filters

To apply jurisdiction-specific tenant-screening filters, include `propertyZip` in the request body with the ZIP code of the property being applied for.

---

## 2\. Generate the PDF report

``` http
GET https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{report}/new-pdf-request/{RequestID}

 ```

- Use the same `{report}` value from Step 1 and the `RequestID` returned in the response header.
    
- Wait approximately **200 milliseconds** after Step 1 before requesting the PDF to allow the report data to become available.
    
- Request the PDF within **24 hours** to avoid generating a second inquiry.
    

---

## 3\. Retrieve an updated report when review is required

Some inquiry attempts require CIC/Asurint to manually review or update a record before the order can be fulfilled. This generally occurs when local tenant-screening regulations affect items in the report.

### Poll for the finalized report

Check the order status and retrieve the finalized report using:

``` http
GET https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{report}/get-response/{responseID}

 ```

The response includes `orderResponse.status`, which tells you where the order is in the review process:

| Status | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Pending` | The order is still in manual review at CIC/Asurint. | Poll again later. |
| `Complete` | Review is finished and the report data is available. | Use the report data in the response. Stop polling. |
| `Security Freeze` | The consumer has placed a security freeze on their file. No results will be returned. | Stop polling. Contact the consumer to lift the freeze before reordering. |

Example response while the order is still in review:

``` json
{
  "orderResponse": {
    "status": "Pending",
    "message": "This applicant cannot be conducted through the automated system at this time. Please contact Customer Service.",
    "responseID": "91919191",
    "name": "SMITH,KEVIN"
  }
}

 ```

### Polling guidance

- CIC/Asurint typically takes several days to complete a manual review. **Poll no more than once per hour per order.**
    
- Set a reasonable timeout on your side (for example, 10 business days). If an order is still `Pending` after that, contact CRS Support with the `responseID`.
    

---

**POST**

`https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{bureau}/credit-report/standard/{config}`

- Returns a JSON credit report in the **CRS Standard Format**.
    
- The `{config}` and `{bureau}` parameters are preconfigured for your sandbox account (examples are included in this Postman Collection).
    
- The `{config}` parameter defines which report configuration to use (set up by CRS).
    
- The response includes a `RequestID` header — capture this value for the next step.
    

### **Step 2: Generate PDF Credit Report**

**POST**

`https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{bureau}/standard-credit-report/pdf/{config}/{RequestID}`

- Returns a PDF version of the report from Step 1.
    
- Use the same `{config}` and `RequestID` values.
    
- Wait about **200 ms** after Step 1 before calling Step 2 to ensure data is available.
    
- Request the PDF within **24 hours** to ensure a single inquiry.
    

### **Step 3: Retrieve an Existing Credit Report**

**POST**

`https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/{bureau}/credit-report/standard/{config}/{RequestID}`

- Retrieves an existing JSON report.

item.name: Accurate Append
item.description:
# AccurateAppend — Unified Reverse

AccurateAppend Unified Reverse resolves person and address information using a known phone number, email address, or both.

## Step 1: Perform a Unified Reverse Lookup

**POST**  
`https://api-sandbox.stitchcredit.com/api/accurate-append/reverse`

Returns person and address information associated with a supplied phone number, email address, or both.

At least one of the following lookup fields is required:

- `phoneNumber`
    
- `emailAddress`
    

The request may also include `firstName` and `lastName` as optional filters. The optional `sources` array can be used to specify which AccurateAppend data sources should be searched. Omit `sources` to use the default source configuration.

### Supported Lookup Options

The Postman collection includes example requests for:

- Reverse lookup by phone number
    
- Reverse lookup by email address
    
- Reverse lookup by phone number with name filters
    
- Reverse lookup by phone number with selected sources
    
- Reverse lookup using both phone number and email address
    

All lookup types use the same `/accurate-append/reverse` endpoint.

### Source Codes

- `D` — Directory
    
- `P` — Proprietary
    
- `M` — Mobile
    
- `C` — Commercial or business
    
- `L` — Landline
    
- `A` — ADS
    

---

## Response

A successful request returns:

- `success`
    
- A completion message
    
- `data.transactionId`
    
- `data.records`
    

Each matching record may include the resolved first name, last name, house number, street, full address, city, state, and postal code.

The `transactionId` is always returned and should be retained for support and traceability.

When no match is found, the request still returns successfully, but the records array is empty:

``` json
"records": []

 ```

An empty `records` array represents a no-hit and is not an API error.

---

## Validation and Authorization

The collection includes negative test requests for common integration errors:

- No phone number or email address — `400 Bad Request`
    
- Phone number is not exactly 10 numeric digits — `400 Bad Request`
    
- Email address is invalid — `400 Bad Request`
    
- Missing or invalid authorization token — `401 Unauthorized`
    
- User does not have the Accurate Append role — `403 Forbidden`
    

Phone numbers must contain exactly 10 digits without spaces, parentheses, or hyphens.

---

## Field Documentation

- [AccurateAppend Unified Reverse — API Documentation](https://crsgroupinc.egnyte.com/dl/GbHckQRGdPGj)
    
- [AccurateAppend Unified Reverse — Test Cases](https://crsgroupinc.egnyte.com/dl/QwFy6yTvp8rT)
